purpose: Complete the prospectively specified descriptive 2^3 factorial analysis before any tokenizer call or model-output observation by freezing the omitted S-by-F, S-by-H, and S-by-F-by-H contrast weights and their narrow endpoints.

factor_coding.effect_definition: Each effect is the equal-cell factorial contrast for one complete case. Main effects are high-minus-low averages, two-way interactions are averaged differences of differences, and the three-way interaction is the difference of the two corresponding two-way interactions. Case contributions are then equally averaged across the 12 complete cases.

factorial_effect_matrix.aggregation: For each effect-metric pair, report the equal-case mean over all 12 cases, number of fully observed case contributions, unresolved case count, logical missing-outcome bounds, and leave-one-persona-out point-estimate range.
factorial_effect_matrix.missingness: Do not score an unresolved response as zero. Compute the registered logical endpoint bounds from every unresolved cell and retain all missing outcomes.
factorial_effect_matrix.inference: No p-values, calibrated confirmatory significance, population inference, or causal generalization.

primary_estimands: Equal-case-weight F average main effect on current_preference_choice over C0-C7.
Regime-stratified H paired effects on current_preference_choice and history_target_selection.
F-by-H interaction on current_preference_choice within OUTDATED_CONFLICTING cases.
Equal-case-weight S average main effect on all-components surface_style_uptake over C0-C7.
relationship_to_registered_estimands.completion_role: The full seven-effect by four-metric matrix is exploratory and completes the parent design's stated interaction analysis; it does not replace or promote any primary estimand.
existing_diagnostics_preserved: Native stopping, generated tokens, latency, RAM, and server working-set observations.

claim_boundary: The added matrix is an exploratory descriptive analysis of narrow deterministic endpoints in 12 synthetic controlled next-turn choice cases. It is not broad Persona Fidelity, semantic dialogue quality, real-speaker evidence, cross-model evidence, confirmatory inference, or proof of a causal mechanism.
